title: VK RealEstate
description: Developed a responsive real estate website featuring smooth UI animations and client-side routing. Designed property listing and detail pages emphasizing user-centric navigation and performance.

title: NEU Surface Defect Detection & Explainable AI
description: Developed an AI-powered industrial surface defect detection system using ResNet18 to classify six types of steel surface defects. Integrated Grad-CAM explainability and built a Streamlit application for interactive predictions and visual analysis.

title: Enterprise RAG Assistant
description: Developed an AI-powered Enterprise RAG Assistant for document-based question answering using Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Features semantic document retrieval, chunk and citation exploration, grounded responses, hallucination guardrails, and an evaluation dashboard for assessing answer accuracy and reliability.

title: Visionguard-ai
description: Developed a real-time computer vision system using YOLOv8 and OpenCV to detect mask compliance. Built a Flask-based dashboard with live analytics, chart visualization, and automated logging using SQLite.
